description: A Jet 4 MDB host made by the probe links T of r-def-cat-txn-lksrc-accdb (ACCDB) as LK through CreateTableDef and TableDefs.Append with a relative Connect. Is the append accepted? Then LK's Connect, SourceTableName, Attributes, Updatable and fields, a read of all rows, INSERT (6, 60, 'six'), UPDATE of row 2 and DELETE of row 3 through LK (dbFailOnError), and a read of the source file itself through a second Database.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
